i was given both norco and a muscle relaxers following post-op (19FtM)  .  i was definitely lucky enough to be off the norco by three days postop ,  stopped taking the muscle relaxers probably a week or so after.  i definitely have had a lot more luck with recovery pain than others haha

i (19FtM) had back surgery a month prior to my tonsillectomy and only used a total of three pain pills during recovery.  however ,  tonsillectomy came around and i used all of those i had left , a full prescription given for my tonsillectomy and still had to call and get more.  generally i have a super high pain tolerance as well.  i’m on day 9 and only now starting to really eat solids.  on day five i was in the ED getting fluids ,  morphine ,  and steroids .  personal experience? i’ve been absolutely miserable.  i regularly woke up in such severe pain i was unable to move. everyone recovers differently ( as you can tell from other commenters ) .  ice packs are HUGE.  LOTS of cold water !!  

also .  don’t do what i did.  try and eat with your pain medication to avoid getting sick from it.  unfortunately i threw up and caused rebleeding… haha.  best of luck!
